item.title: DadaProgressions Beta 26.3
item.description: Beta 26.3 finishes the point-rule editor and improves event debugging.
item.content:encoded:
Beta 26.3 finishes the point-rule editor and improves event debugging.

Point rules​

Each rule can now have its own when-mode: ALL|ANY.

- when-mode: ALL
  when:
    material: [DIAMOND_ORE]
    world: [survival]
  set: 10

ALL requires both conditions; ANY requires only one. Rules are checked from top to bottom and the first match wins. Old rules still default to ALL.

Editor​

The point screen can change the base amount, rounding, operation, value, conditions and rule order. It supports both SET and MULTIPLY rules.

Debug​

The debug output now shows which point rule won and the calculation from base to final points.

/dp admin debug <goalId> <onlinePlayer> [timeoutSeconds]
/dp admin debug cancel <onlinePlayer>

The timeout is 60 seconds by default and accepts values from 5 to 600.

YAML schema​

A JSON Schema for goal files is included for autocomplete and basic checks in IntelliJ and other compatible editors.

item.title: DadaProgressions Beta 26.2
item.description: Beta 26.2 makes complex goals easier to edit and debug.
item.content:encoded:
Beta 26.2 makes complex goals easier to edit and debug.

Filters​

Filter groups now support filter-mode: ALL and filter-mode: ANY, both on the goal and on individual criteria.

New filters:

  • biome
  • min-y / max-y
  • min-amount / max-amount

include is the allow-list and exclude is the veto-list. If the same value appears in both, exclude wins.

Editor​

/dp admin editor can now manage goals, composite criteria, filters and prerequisites. Numeric values use a keypad; known values such as materials, entities and worlds use paginated selectors.

Changes are validated before they are kept. If something is invalid, the previous file and active configuration are restored.

Debug and validation​

Use this command before performing an action with the selected player:

/dp admin debug <goalId> <onlinePlayer>

It shows the real event values, filter results, points, prerequisites and cooldown.

/dp admin validate checks the files without loading them. /dp admin reload now keeps the previous working goals if a new file is broken.

item.title: DadaProgressions Beta 26.1
item.description: Beta 26.1 adds modular goals and cleans up notifications.
item.content:encoded:
Beta 26.1 adds modular goals and cleans up notifications.

Goals​

  • Goals can contain several criteria joined with AND or OR.
  • Each criterion keeps its own progress.
  • Added filters for materials, entities, worlds, game modes, permissions, commands, damage causes and attribution.
  • Point rules can assign fixed values or multipliers.
  • Goals can require another goal to be completed, either in the current period or at any time in the past.
  • Animal breeding is now tracked automatically, including on older server versions.

The default files include a few community goals that use the new system. Existing simple goals still work as before.

Notifications​

Chat, action bar, title and boss bar now have separate queues. Repeated updates are grouped instead of sending a message for every single action.

Chat can also combine updates from different goals into one line. Timing, queue size and channel limits remain configurable.

GUI​

Goal entries now show the actual objective and useful progress values. The longer technical state text is hidden by default and can be restored with gui.list.goal-item.show-state-lore.
